data.name: Protocol Zero
data.detailed_description: Protocol Zero is a hardcore, realism-driven survival game set somewhere in post-apocalyptic Europe after a global nuclear catastrophe. The world lies in ruins, cities abandoned, landscapes irradiated, and life twisted by mutation. Built for players who seek a true survival challenge, it features advanced survival mechanics, realistic visuals, and unforgiving combat against both mutant creatures and hostile human factions. Manage hunger, radiation, temperature, and stamina as you scavenge, craft, and adapt to a collapsing ecosystem. Engage in tactical PvE and PvP encounters where precision, awareness, and strategy are the keys to survival. In this world shaped by nuclear fallout and desperation, every choice defines who you become. Remember, you have a choice.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64bit versions required)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2500K or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 1030 or Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Low Settings
pc_requirements.recommended:

  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64bit versions required)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon RX 5500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
